mapper.select: SELECT er.*, e.title as examTitle, e.total_score as totalScore, e.pass_score as passScore FROM exam_record er JOIN exam e ON er.exam_id = e.id WHERE er.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY er.submit_time DESC

SELECT er.*, e.title as examTitle, e.total_score as totalScore, e.pass_score as passScore, sys_user.name as studentName FROM exam_record er JOIN exam e ON er.exam_id = e.id JOIN sys_user ON er.user_id = sys_user.id ORDER BY er.submit_time DESC
SELECT er.* FROM exam_record er WHERE er.user_id = #{userId} AND er.exam_id = #{examId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO exam_record (exam_id, user_id, answers, score, is_passed) VALUES (#{examId}, #{userId}, #{answers}, #{score}, #{isPassed})
mapper.update: UPDATE exam_record SET score = #{score}, is_passed = #{isPassed} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM exam_record WHERE exam_id = #{examId}
